lines.en: I crawl over pale blue petals.
In the maze level, we travel in packs.

lines.zh: 细腿一排排敲着末地石。
lines.en: My little legs tap the end stone in ranks.

lines.zh: 我顺着塔壁往上爬半格。
lines.en: I climb halfway up the tower wall.
The flower stem is my road; do not tread it.

lines.zh: 我们排队穿过巨花的阴影。
lines.en: We file through the giant flower's shadow.

lines.zh: 我快走几步，追上前面的。
lines.en: I scurry to catch up with the one ahead.

lines.zh: 蔚蓝森林的花粉落了我一身。
lines.en: Pollen from the azure forest coats me.
I hug the wall's base to save effort.

lines.zh: 迷宫拐角处，我们换队形。
lines.en: At the corner, we change formation.

lines.zh: 我拖着花浆的味道走动。
lines.en: I walk trailing the smell of flower sap.
Small steps, but never stopping.
Step on a petal and the foot sticks.

lines.zh: 我们沿着塔基绕一整圈。
lines.en: We circle the tower's base once.
I rest in the flower's heart, still.

lines.zh: 末地没有太阳，花也开着。
lines.en: No sun in the End, yet the flowers open.

lines.zh: 我把腿收在身下装着花蕊。
lines.en: I tuck my legs in and pass for a stamen.
I wait for a companion to move first.

lines.zh: 塔里很静，只有我们在呼吸。
lines.en: The tower is quiet, but for our breathing.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听迷宫里的回音。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the maze's echoes.
Flower sap creeps slowly through my belly.

lines.zh: 我张开又合上薄薄的翅。
lines.en: I open and close my thin wings.

lines.zh: 末地石不长草，我却活得下去。
lines.en: No grass on end stone, yet I thrive.

lines.zh: 这层迷宫我熟得能闭眼。
lines.en: I know this maze well enough to shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在数塔顶漏下的光点。
lines.en: I count the specks of light from above.
My shell hardened; I mind being stepped on less.

lines.zh: 同伴靠过来，我挪了半寸。
lines.en: A companion nears; I shift half an inch.
Holding still, I am just a small flower.

lines.zh: 我在等花蕊裂开的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the flower's core to split.

lines.zh: 这层没有风，花瓣也不摇。
lines.en: No wind here; not one petal stirs.
I fold my mouthparts and rest.
Even the maze walls are quieter than I.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我们的一朵花。
lines.en: You crushed one of our flowers.

lines.zh: 抬头看我，我就在你脚边。
lines.en: Look down. I am right at your feet.
You must be the new tower-breaker.
Do not grab. I bite.
I have counted how many swords you carry.

lines.zh: 末地好久没这么热闹了。
lines.en: The End has not been this lively in ages.
You humans always walk downward.
I know the smell of blood. Yours is thin.
Flower sap tastes better than your skin.

lines.zh: 你要过这层迷宫？先过我。
lines.en: Cross this maze? Past me first.

lines.zh: 我离你很近，你没发觉吧。
lines.en: I am close, and you never noticed.

lines.zh: 别盯着我，同伴在另一边。
lines.en: Do not stare at me; my kin are behind you.
My shell cracks; I flinch.
Do not step! My leg is crushed.
Flower sap splashes out. It hurts.
I flip over and scramble upright.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了半片翅。
lines.en: That cost me half a wing.
My kin heard me chirp.
My shell is thin. It stops little.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，花粉落了一地。
lines.en: I shake, and pollen scatters.
My blood runs pale blue.

lines.zh: 薄翅撕开一道口，飞不稳了。
lines.en: A tear splits my thin wing; I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 你拿花来引我？真有胆子。
lines.en: Luring me with a flower? Bold.
That bloom's nectar is not sweet enough.

lines.zh: 我只吃末地的花，不吃面包。
lines.en: I eat End flowers, not bread.
Set the flower down and step back.
That one is foreign. I will not touch it.
The nectar is in the heart, far from your hand.
I smell sweetness and my feet move on their own.
Take it away. I prefer to forage.
The stem of your flower is snapped.
Too sweet. My kin are already coming.
You kicked me. Watch your step.
My shell slips and bumps your leg.

lines.zh: 别挤，迷宫的路只这么宽。
lines.en: Do not crowd; the maze is this narrow.
One bump and I bite along with it.
You are standing on my leg. Lift it.
We come as a crowd. Make way.

lines.zh: 甲壳擦过靴子，声音很脆。
lines.en: Shell scrapes boot with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 碰我一下就够你痒半天。
lines.en: One touch and you itch for hours.

lines.zh: 我在塔的迷宫层里，成群咬。
lines.en: In the tower maze, we bite as a pack.
My wings hit your face. Sorry.
In a flower's heart we lay our eggs.
Born in swarms, raised in swarms.

lines.zh: 这问题得问花，不问我们。
lines.en: Ask the flower that, not us.
The End's blooming is brief. Be quick.
Our young eat only the flower's core.
We pair by scent, not by color.
Look away. This is the flower's business.

lines.zh: 同一朵花下，能聚十几只。
lines.en: A dozen of us gather under one bloom.
Our eggs are clear as dew.

lines.zh: 下一代会继续守这座塔。
lines.en: The next brood will keep this tower too.
I will carry off this grain of pollen.
The petal you dropped is ours now.

lines.zh: 我用前腿夹起一小块花浆。
lines.en: I pinch up a bit of flower sap.

lines.zh: 地上的种子能种出巨花。
lines.en: A seed here could grow a giant flower.
I drag it, though it is bigger than me.
Crumbs are food too. Nothing wasted.
This is sticky; several of us must haul it.

lines.zh: 我把卵挪到安全的花萼里。
lines.en: I move the eggs into a safe calyx.
That torn cloth will line my nest.

lines.zh: 我抱起一块花浆，先藏进花萼。
lines.en: I lift a chunk of nectar and hide it in a calyx first.
He stepped on a flower. All at once.
I smell blood. Target chosen.
Kin, ring his ankles.
My wings tense. I am about to leap.
This maze is ours. Go.
He came from above. Cut him off.

lines.zh: 一口就够，然后换下一个。
lines.en: One bite, then the next of us.

lines.zh: 他的靴子缝，是最好下口处。
lines.en: The seam of his boot is the best place to bite.

lines.zh: 我顺着他的靴子往上爬。
lines.en: I start climbing his boot.
Prey inside the tower cannot flee.
We tighten the ring around you.
I clamp onto his trouser cuff.

lines.zh: 他每退一步，我们进两步。
lines.en: Each step he retreats, we take two.

lines.zh: 花丛里全是我们的动静。
lines.en: The flower bed rustles with all of us.
Do not step; three of us are at your feet.
I poke out of a crack in the wall.
He is panting. He is tiring.
Hold the ankle until the others come.
Our bites are shallow, but there are many.

lines.zh: 迷宫让他绕圈，我们不绕。
lines.en: The maze makes him circle. We do not.
I bite his ankle and hold.
My mouthparts close; blood blooms.
I leap to his calf and tear a line.
This bite is for that flower.

lines.zh: 我们同时咬，他顾不过来。
lines.en: We bite together; he cannot cover all.
Fine teeth sink in like needles.
Bite, hop away, bite again.
I gnaw my way up his sleeve.
He swats me; I switch to the other leg.
The taste of sap mixes with blood.

lines.zh: 巨花下一窝幼虫翻出来。
lines.en: A brood spills out beneath the giant flower.
The tower's maze level wakes.

lines.zh: 我们成群，从花萼里钻出。
lines.en: In swarms we crawl from the calyx.

lines.zh: 墙缝里开始有细碎的响。
lines.en: Tiny noises start inside the wall seams.

lines.zh: 花粉落下来，我们也落地。
lines.en: Pollen drifts down, and so do we.
The flower opens; time for us to emerge.

lines.zh: 这一层今天有新的守卫。
lines.en: This level has new guards today.
The sound starts low and dense.

lines.zh: 我踩在花蕊上，慢慢站定。
lines.en: I set foot on the stamen and steady myself.
A rustle runs along the tower's base.
The whole flower bed is moving.

lines.zh: 第一只出来了，还有下一只。
lines.en: The first is out. More follow.
A spark and my wings curl up.

lines.zh: 从塔壁掉下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: Off the tower wall; my shell lands first.

lines.zh: 卤水淹到腿，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Brine reaches my legs; I cannot float.
The blast throws me into the flowers.
An arrow slips between my plates.

lines.zh: 咒力把我的腿钉在地上。
lines.en: Magic pins my legs to the stone.

lines.zh: 离了花太久，我开始发虚。
lines.en: Too long from flowers and I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷下来，我全身的毛都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning falls; every hair on me stands.

lines.zh: 虚空吞了我的同伴，也叫了我。
lines.en: The void took my kin and calls me too.
